An '''artillery line''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Artillery lines comprised four [[artillery section]]s totalling thirty-eight men. Artillery lines were either equipped with four heavy or medium artillery tubes, or eight light artillery tubes.<ref name="ISB" /> Artillery lines could be augmented by the addition of two more [[artillery section]]s, a [[line squad]], and a [[heavy weapons squad]].<ref name="ISB2" />
